title: Exterior styling draws compliments
summary: This topic is mainly about owners reporting that the G70’s appearance attracts attention and compliments, though one sampled fragment is unrelated and most examples are marked undetermined.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe owners liking the vehicle’s appearance, especially the illuminated grille, and receiving compliments on its looks.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention the car drawing attention or compliments for its styling, but one fragment discusses warning notifications instead.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
The topic cluster includes at least one unrelated fragment about warning notifications, which weakens topic coherence.
Samples are stratified and not representative estimates of all G70 reviews.
